verdict.rationale: Qapita's own docs say its cap table is a single source of truth for employees as well as founders and investors (docs-4), and that it helps companies communicate stock plans covering grants, vesting and exercises (docs-7, docs-8). That implies some employee-facing visibility, but there is no explicit employee portal, and the scenario planning it does document belongs to the investor portal (docs-18), so it cannot be credited to employees. Missing for 10: an explicitly documented employee self-service portal, display of vesting progress and strike price to employees, employee-facing outcome or exit-value modeling, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
